purpose: Place an action before an important upcoming event.
keywords: talk about time sequence duration habits
N / V dictionary + に先立ち / に先立って
Before the performance, we will explain the evacuation routes.
Before construction, we explained the project to local residents.
Before beginning the study, we obtained the participants’ consent.
formation: N / V dictionary + に先立ち / に先立って
restrictions: Usually describes preparation before a planned significant occasion.
mistake: Use 前に for an ordinary everyday sequence.
